observations.fact: LocalOnlyHotspot session authenticated and accepted first TCP 28570 ms after StartSession; video rendered at requested decoder operating rate 30. User reports manually joining this hotspot.
Later manual hotspot session used requested rate and decoder operating rate 60; channel remained unknown. This disproves a universal 30 fps cap but is not a measured sustained 60 fps claim.
Both established sessions completed tunneled iAP2 authentication and released Bluetooth RFCOMM bootstrap; this says nothing about A2DP/HFP disconnection.

Report does not contain media-key focus owner transitions, interception success/failure or outbound pause command origins; wheel-driven OEM page launch and automatic pause are user observations with cause unconfirmed.
USB StartSession sent while announced IPv6 address was tentative; address later became ready and neighbor reachable, but no AirPlay TCP accepted.
Current wireless attempts reached hotspot ready and sent Wi-Fi credentials but did not establish AirPlay; USB fallback VPN consent activity launch failed.
Wireless AirPlay session established, first video frame and subsequent rendering recorded.
Control connection aborted; replacement began after 4-second teardown timeout, before old Bonjour and hotspot release at about 10 seconds.
USB authentication succeeded and system usb0 listener attached, but no AirPlay session before fallback timeout.
VPN consent activity launch failed with ActivityNotFoundException; ADB authorization unreachable; connection failed.
